title: lasiocephalus otophorus
intro: Lasiocephalus otophorus, commonly known as the "False Jasmine", is a type of flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lasiocephalus otophorus include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
